question: To whom must the sacred teaching never be given according to this prohibition?
premises: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva
It must not be given to one who slanders the Kula Bhairava
inference: Revilers of Shiva and slanderers of Kula Bhairava are excluded from receiving it
uncertainties: The verb of giving is implied from context
plain_english: Not to a reviler of Shiva, O goddess, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
